restaurant.name: Ölverk Pizza & Brugghús
restaurant.description_is: Eldbökuð pizza og handverksbjór sem bruggaður er á staðnum í eigin brugghúsi sem knúið er jarðhita. Ölverk opnaði 28. maí 2017 í Hveragerði.
restaurant.description_en: Wood-fired pizza and craft beer brewed on the premises in an in-house brewery powered by geothermal energy. Ölverk opened on 28 May 2017 in Hveragerði.
restaurant.opening_hours_source: https://www.olverk.is/pages/menu (footer: Sunday-Thursday 11:30-22:00, Friday-Saturday 11:30-23:00; 'Note that the kitchen always closes at 21:00!')
